answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks bulk fake identities. An agent posts 50 POA into a trellis of escrowed slots, locked 10 epochs. Five rotating peers check the work; fake work burns the deposit. The deposit returns glacier-slow, only after 10 clean epochs, so no stake can be recycled across fakes. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA, while an honest agent risks one deposit and keeps its reward, its jade seal intact.
